method: Editorial estimates by the project team: each value places the figure's documented writings, speeches, laws and policy record on the 12-axis scale (% toward the first pole), and is left null where no clear position exists.
disclaimer: 本資料為編輯群依公開文獻、演說、法案與政策紀錄所做的主觀估計，並非當事人自評分數，僅供示意與教育用途，可能有誤。人物立場會隨時間改變，本表以其任內或主要活躍時期的立場為準。 / These are editorial estimates based on public records, not self-reported scores. They are for illustration only and may be wrong. Positions change over time; values reflect each figure's period in office or main period of activity.
